proposal.selected_direction: Mobile-first fitness club landing with trial-class CTA; prices, address and timetable unknown
implementation_plan: Render mobile and desktop previews using available authorized tools
Seek explicit approval for a specific visual version before writing frontend code

design_quality.product_specific_direction: Editorial athletic-club identity emphasizing real training atmosphere and class discovery; unverified claims are placeholders.
design_quality.selected_over_alternative: Editorial training story preferred over generic SaaS cards because physical place and training are primary.
generic_template_risks: Avoid interchangeable three-tier SaaS pricing cards without actual club membership evidence
Replace feature grid of generic marketing benefits with training and facilities narrative
Reject invented growth statistics or unlicensed stock hero imagery

directions.title: Editorial gym culture
directions.product_story: A real training community with credible instructors and day-to-day class rhythm
directions.information_architecture: Starts with training culture and class discovery, then coach proof, location and trial
directions.composition: Full-bleed training moment then wide editorial columns alternating with a compact class timetable
directions.typography_and_imagery: Condensed functional headlines paired with documentary training photography, real rights pending
directions.primary_interaction: Choose class format and request a trial through a clearly marked demo inquiry
directions.tradeoff: Stronger emotional brand presence but needs real documentary imagery and reliable schedule data

directions.title: Neighborhood training field guide
directions.product_story: Help nearby first-timers feel comfortable and find their first suitable class
directions.information_architecture: Start with location and what to expect, then beginner routes and practical visit preparation
directions.composition: Map-like chapter navigation with stacked annotated venue fragments and a step-by-step visitor path
directions.typography_and_imagery: Warm explanatory typography and diagrammatic illustration rather than monumental hero photography
directions.primary_interaction: Guide me to a class using an accessible three-step preference choice
directions.tradeoff: Comforting for newcomers but less dynamic for athletes who know the club

directions.title: Focused training outcomes
directions.product_story: Experienced athletes need equipment, formats and precise session details rather than generic hype
directions.information_architecture: Start with equipment and session formats, then coaching credentials and timetable lookup
directions.composition: Dense training-spec layout with vertical programme index and full-width session detail
directions.typography_and_imagery: Numerical sport editorial hierarchy and factual equipment images, without unverified metrics
directions.primary_interaction: Filter session types and examine exact details before inquiry
directions.tradeoff: Strong practical relevance but can feel utilitarian to casual visitors

design_exploration.selection_rationale: Training culture and class discovery answer the stated ambition without a generic product-feature grid, provided real images and class facts are obtained.

rejections.reason: Better for first-time anxiety but too instructional for the intended energetic positioning.
Highly practical but insufficient emphasis on club atmosphere for an introductory landing page.

cross_domain_swap_test.explanation: Documentary training moments, session discovery and venue-visit navigation cannot carry a bookkeeping subscription funnel without changing the information architecture and imagery.
